issues.reason: No word in the text says the Devil Rays are a team — the kind comes only from knowing the franchise — and Core patterns states that world knowledge picks the reading but never adds content: point at the words or drop the atom.

On a `doubt`-class eventuality `Experiencer` names the holder of the psych state, so the atom says the future does the doubting; "is in doubt" names no doubter and makes the future what the doubt is about.

The half that stands is that the modifier does not reach the individual problems; it is overstated as a defect, since "unspecified" is a property of the collection as the announcement described it (the carve-out the same paragraph allows for properties of the collection itself), nothing false is asserted, and no distribution `Implication` could be emitted inside the sealed complement anyway.

gaps_confirmed: predicative PP as a copular complement ("is in doubt", "at risk", "under review") — adjectival predicates and locative/domain PPs are covered, idiomatic predicate PPs are not, and the "in" mapping otherwise forces the false `LocatedIn`
a content noun taking a clausal complement ("an announcement he will miss the season") — sealing under `Theme` is defined for attitude verbs only, never for an event-denoting noun
new_gaps: a descriptive modifier on a bare plural whose whole predication is sealed — the distributive rule the plural rules require cannot be emitted as an `Implication` inside a sealed term
an attributive organization-name modifier on a common noun ("Devil Rays prospect Josh Hamilton") — the affiliation link is improvised (here `PartOf`) with nothing licensing it
repair_summary: Removed (Member devil_rays team), the world-knowledge typing (the `Name` atom keeps the referent identified, as the prompt's own name-only examples do); re-slotted the doubt state's role atom from `Experiencer` to `Stimulus`, the licensed psych-state object role, leaving the doubter unstated as an agentless passive does.
notes: The reified doubt state is kept because it anchors the `Before` ordering, and the flat `(In sk_future_1 doubt)` carries the predication; `BecauseOf` and the tenseless announcement anchor are untouched.
